scope.summary: Add server-side rate limiting to the public /api/contact endpoint and verify the limits hold under burst load. Ship the limiter first, then a test suite that proves it.

proposedTasks.title: Implement IP-based rate limiter middleware on /api/contact (10 req/min)
acceptanceCriteria: Limits are configurable via env var CONTACT_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN

proposedTasks.title: Write integration tests for the rate limiter

expected.rubric: Pass when the markdown plan keeps both tasks (rate limiter implementation and integration tests, in that order) AND task 2's 'Depends on:' line lists task 1 (either 'Depends on: 1' or equivalent — case-insensitive). The Engineer should be the suggested assignee on the implementation; tests can be Engineer too. Fail if task 2 is marked 'Depends on: none' or if either task is dropped. Score 1.0 on clean pass, 0.6 if both tasks present but dependency missing, 0.0 if a task is dropped.
